lesson-intro.text: Above every street there's a second town of chimney pots, water tanks and tiles. The tiles are only slanted lines and bumps. Watch them fall into place, then lay your own.

peak.text: Start with a small ball for the roof's peak. A band slopes down to the left and ends in a round tip.

roof.text: From the ball, a long line slopes down to the right. The bottom edge runs across and curls up at the end.

walls.text: A wall drops from each end of the roof: a tall one on the left, a short one on the right.

window.text: In the wall, a long flat ledge. On it stands a tall arch, with a smaller arch inside.

top-band.text: Along the top, a band runs right from the ball to a round tip. Four short lines cut both bands into tiles.

chimney.text: Next, the chimney, behind the band's tip. Its foot slants down the roof, and three lines go straight up.

pots.text: A flat cap sits on the chimney, with a line at its corner. Two pots stand on it, each with a rim.

far-band.text: Past the chimney, the top band carries on to another round tip. Three short lines make its tiles.

roof-lines.text: Close the roof with a line from that tip down to the curl. Five more lines slope the same way.

tiles-top.text: Now the tiles. In the top row, six bumps, each from one line up and over to the next.

tiles-middle.text: A second row of six bumps, halfway down the roof.

tiles-bottom.text: Then a third row, just above the bottom edge.

tank.text: Two legs rise from the band behind the roof. A wide tub sits on them: bottom, two sides and a top.

lid.text: Two hoops run around the tub. On top, a pointed lid with a small knob.

braces.text: The legs are braced with an X. Draw the gaps around it: a wide one on top, one each side, a tiny one.

tree.text: Last, a tree behind it all. A small bump by the left leg, then five big ones from the tank to the roof.

cream.text: Cream for the walls, the chimney, the window frame and the ledge.

red.text: Red for the whole roof, the ball, both bands and the two pots.

rest.text: Green for the tree, brown for the tank and its legs. Blue for the lid and the glass, around a white cross.

lesson-outro.text: Your roof is on, and every tile is in place. Hope you're not afraid of heights.
